rows: List CVEs affecting a CPE name from the NVD 2.0 API (paginated, bounded)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: List the CVEs that affect a given CPE 2.3 product name (e.g. cpe:2.3:a:apache:log4j:2.14.1:*:*:*:*:*:*:*) using the NVD 2.0 API, returning each CVE identifier with its description, CVSS base score, qualitative severity, and publication date. Results are paginated server-side and bounded.
rows.vgi.doc_md: List CVEs affecting a CPE 2.3 product name via the NVD 2.0 API, e.g. `cpe_cves('cpe:2.3:a:apache:log4j:2.14.1:*:*:*:*:*:*:*')`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List only the high/critical CVEs affecting Apache Log4j 2.14.1, worst first.","sql":"SELECT cve_id, description, cvss_score, cvss_severity FROM cve.main.cpe_cves('cpe:2.3:a:apache:log4j:2.14.1:*:*:*:*:*:*:*') WHERE cvss_severity IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') ORDER BY cvss_score DESC;"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"cve_id","type":"VARCHAR","description":"The CVE identifier affecting the CPE."},{"name":"description","type":"VARCHAR","description":"English description of the vulnerability."},{"name":"cvss_score","type":"DOUBLE","description":"CVSS base score (0.0-10.0); NULL when the CVE has no metrics yet."},{"name":"cvss_severity","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Qualitative band: NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL."},{"name":"published","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Publication timestamp (ISO 8601)."}]
rows.vgi.title: CVEs Affecting a CPE

rows: SELECT cve_id, description, cvss_score, cvss_severity FROM cve.main.cpe_cves('cpe:2.3:a:apache:log4j:2.14.1:*:*:*:*:*:*:*') WHERE cvss_severity IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') ORDER BY cvss_score DESC;
Fetch a single CVE record by ID from the NVD 2.0 API

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Fetch a single CVE record by its identifier (e.g. CVE-2021-44228) from the NVD 2.0 API, returning its description, CVSS base score, qualitative severity, CVSS vector, published and last-modified timestamps, and associated CWE. Returns no rows for an unknown CVE.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Fetch one CVE record by ID from the NVD 2.0 API, e.g. `cve('CVE-2021-44228')`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Look up the Log4Shell CVE and keep only its critical-severity scoring and CWE.","sql":"SELECT id, cvss_score, cvss_severity, cwe FROM cve.main.cve('CVE-2021-44228') WHERE cvss_score \u003e= 9.0;"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"id","type":"VARCHAR","description":"The CVE identifier, e.g. CVE-2021-44228."},{"name":"description","type":"VARCHAR","description":"English description of the vulnerability."},{"name":"cvss_score","type":"DOUBLE","description":"CVSS base score (0.0-10.0); NULL when the CVE has no metrics yet."},{"name":"cvss_severity","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Qualitative band: NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL."},{"name":"cvss_vector","type":"VARCHAR","description":"The CVSS v3.1 vector string."},{"name":"published","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Publication timestamp (ISO 8601)."},{"name":"last_modified","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Last-modified timestamp (ISO 8601)."},{"name":"cwe","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Associated CWE identifier(s)."}]
rows.vgi.title: CVE Lookup by ID

rows: SELECT id, cvss_score, cvss_severity, cwe FROM cve.main.cve('CVE-2021-44228') WHERE cvss_score >= 9.0;
Keyword-search the NVD 2.0 API (paginated, bounded to 100 results)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Keyword-search CVE descriptions through the NVD 2.0 API and return the matching CVEs with their description, CVSS base score, qualitative severity, and publication date. Results are paginated server-side and bounded to 100 rows.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Keyword-search CVE descriptions via the NVD 2.0 API, e.g. `cve_search('log4j')`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Rank the scored 'log4j' CVEs by CVSS base score, most severe first.","sql":"SELECT id, cvss_score, cvss_severity FROM cve.main.cve_search('log4j') WHERE cvss_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cvss_score DESC;"}]
rows.vgi.keywords: ["cve search","keyword search","search vulnerabilities","nvd","full text","advisory lookup","cvss","find cves"]

Compute the CVSS v3.1 base score from a vector string

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Compute the CVSS v3.1 base score (0.0-10.0) from a CVSS vector string such as 'CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H'. Implements the official base equation (impact, exploitability, scope, spec roundup) entirely offline. A malformed vector raises an error.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Compute the CVSS v3.1 base score from a vector string, e.g. the Log4Shell vector -> `9.8`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Compute the CVSS v3.1 base score for the Log4Shell vector (returns 9.8).","sql":"SELECT cve.main.cvss_base_score('CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H');"}]
rows.vgi.title: CVSS Base Score Calculator

rows: Map a CVSS base score (0.0-10.0) to NONE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Map a numeric CVSS v3.1 base score in the range 0.0-10.0 to its qualitative severity band: NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL. Offline, deterministic, no network. Use to bucket and triage vulnerabilities by severity.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Map a CVSS base score (0.0-10.0) to its severity band, e.g. `cvss_severity(9.8)` -> `'CRITICAL'`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Map a numeric CVSS base score to its qualitative band (returns 'CRITICAL').","sql":"SELECT cve.main.cvss_severity(9.8);"}]
rows.vgi.title: CVSS Severity Band
